name: Agentic Private Office — Matthew Keddy
description: The Agentic Private Office of Matthew Keddy. AI-native brands in capital markets, consumer and retail AI shopping, and pharma, generating 100M+ in AI agent and human traffic a month.
longDescription:
The Agentic Private Office of Matthew Keddy holds a portfolio of AI-native brands in three markets: capital markets, consumer and retail AI shopping, and pharma. Together they generate 100M+ in AI agent and human traffic a month, across global markets in the Americas, the EU and UK, and Asia.
IRL agent-ready data products: the record of real things, built for AI agents that act in real life. Not training data for the labs. Not synthetic data from a model. Real products, real issuers and real medicines, each with its source.
The record is served live on Model Context Protocol (MCP), in real time on Microsoft Azure across 20+ hyperscale cloud regions, with Amazon Web Services held as standby.
Products: AI-native Optimize, for agents already running, paid as they go on x402 machine payments. AI-native Design & Build, for enterprises building their own agents, by arrangement. RCO (Record of Cleared Orders), for compliance teams: a signed receipt for every read.
